prompt.title: AI Force Package #8
prompt.text:
Target Card B35: Kingston – Army Support.
Deployment table: Troops 1 row × Naval Balance “≥60” column → Force Package #8.
Package #8: 1st Force: Main ships totaling 8 points of Close Action strength, on an Army Support mission transporting Troops. 2nd Force: any other remaining Main or Secondary ships totaling 22 points of Long Gun strength, in the same Lake Zone, with a Patrol mission. Roll 1d6 for which Force is in an Encounter with the British: odd = Army Support Force, even = Patrol Force.
Select the American ships that meet it (Main Ships first, then Secondary; fewest ships that meet the requirement; Long Gun = printed value) [5.3.1]. Select none if the package's requirements cannot be met.
Select the ships for both Forces together. On the next screen, choose which of those ships form the Patrol.
